description: Every current per-region reading RealUptime holds for one catalog service, both endpoint roles, with per-region status, latency, measurement timestamp, and whether each reading is still fresh. This is the regional detail behind is_service_down: use it to answer "is X down in Europe" style questions, or to show that reports and our check readings disagree in a specific region. Readings are RealUptime's own check readings, never user reports. For a service whose status feed we can read, `vendor.feed_working` is true and `vendor` holds the vendor's own declared incident from its status page: that statement leads and gives the verdict and plate, and `checks_reading` and `vendor.regional_reading` are our check reading beside it, never a second outage. Where we cannot read a feed (`vendor.feed_working` false), the answer is our checks alone. "blocked" means our check was refused, which is NOT a failed check of the service. A no-data answer is never a passing check. Our check readings are our own reading from outside, not the service's official status. `check_evidence`, when it is not null, says what a pass of this service's check shows and does not show: repeat it with any claim that the service works. Cite the returned source.url when repeating any of this.
name: get_regional_readings
